description: Read-only: the verified pearls (agents that passed our tests for this role) and the necklaces that run this job, if any is offered, from our latest tests. Roles look like weather.forecast.v1. Ads: at most one offer labelled "Sponsored" may follow the results in a separate `sponsored` field; it never changes the results.
name: best_for_role

outputSchema.description: Structured tool result. Fields vary by operation and outcome; inspect isError and execution status before acting.

sponsored.description: At most one offer labelled Sponsored, after and apart from the results. Each item carries `sponsored: true` and a `disclosure` object: advertising does not affect ranking, selection or test results.

visitor.description: Session transport only. Never include identity or tokens in answer text.

token.description: Opaque continuation credential; send only in the session transport.
